Build a planscanR cache-backed record provider.

Source: R/curation_records.R
curation_records_provider_cache.Rd

When the default planscanR::index_cache() is used, the provider passes the bounded row-transform seam through to the leaf package. Its read callback also retains a versioned fingerprint of every successfully decoded complete row for curation_records_snapshot() provenance metadata.

Usage

curation_records_provider_cache(
  cache_dir,
  index_fn = planscanR::index_cache,
  batch_size = 512L
)

Arguments

cache_dir

Explicit planscanR cache root.

index_fn

Injectable equivalent of planscanR::index_cache() for offline fixtures. It must accept cache_dir and country.

batch_size

Number of cache rows combined per leaf index batch. The default is 512 and is passed to the leaf row-transform seam when the default planscanR::index_cache() is used.

Value

A planscanR_curation_records_provider object.
